text:
maria: Heads up — racks arrive next week to SJC3. Need double-check on power & cooling capacities before vendors ship. Procurement ticket #PRO-4567. Who owns final sign-off? cc @aj @carter

aj: I can take point on power checks. Two quick Qs: 1) Are these H100 80GB racks? 2) Do we need 400V PDUs or 208V?

maria: Yes H100 80GB. Vendor spec says 8kW per rack nominal, burst to 10kW. Assume 400V. Thanks :thumbsup:

opsbot: ticket update: PRO-4567 transitioned to "Facilities review" by @aj — 2026-03-10 09:12

carter: We reserved capacity pool 'dedicated-west-2a' but billing said we only have quota for 6 racks. What's our target? @finance

olivia: SRE note: Plan to run canary on 1 rack for 48h after install. Need monitoring hooks + alerting. I'll create playbook and add it to the runbook.

leo: Facility on-site: SJC3 power feed A and B validated. Cooling units CU-7 & CU-8 have spare ~12% capacity, but will need setpoint tweak to stay within thermal margin. PDU availability confirmed for 400V.

aj: Great. Next steps: run power test with vendor on Tue 2026-03-17. I'll post test command output after. Also need rack elevation plan from facilities (U-space, cable trays, PDUs).

maria: Can we get the vendor to hold shipment until after the test? Procurement said tentative ship date 2026-03-18.

carter: If we need to increase quota to 8 racks I can escalate to salesops. For short term can we convert 2 reserved slots from the burst pool? That'd cover 8.

olivia: I'll prep the canary alert rules: GPU error_count > 0, host_temp >= 85C, token_latency p95 > 120ms. Adding sample alert block to runbook:

```
alert: GPU_Temp_Over
expr: host_temp_celsius > 85
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: high
annotations:
  summary: "GPU temp high on {{ $labels.instance }}"
```

aj: Posting PDU wiring snippet for vendor:

```
PDUs:
- type: 400V
  feeds: A/B
  per_rack_max_kw: 10
  connector: IEC309
```

maria: Thanks all. @aj please confirm ship hold and post final sign-off here once tests pass. I'll update procurement and stake holders. :eyes:

aj: Will do. I assigned a facilities ticket and invited the vendor to the power test. Will report back after test completion.
